title: fix(app-shell): a hidden tab polls the bell and approvals feeds every three minutes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：控制台标签页转到后台后，铃铛（收件箱）和审批角标改为每 3 分钟查一次（原来与前台一样每 1 分钟）；后台满 10 分钟后全停、回到标签页时每个数据源立刻读一次，这两条不变。
- 为什么改：#27907 把前台轮询改成 60 秒后，后台的 60 秒不再比前台慢，前 10 分钟里一个后台标签页和前台一样频繁地请求。按裁决 B（6522899149）把后台节奏调回明显慢于前台。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个常量和注释；后台标签页的桌面通知最晚约 3 分钟到达（原来约 1 分钟）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`sharedUserFeeds.ts` 的 `HIDDEN_POLL_MS` 及其注释；`sharedUserFeeds.hiddenStop-12439.test.tsx` 新增的 "reads at most 4 times" 用例；`.changeset/27626-record-open-requests.md` 那一句的改正。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/sharedUserFeeds.hiddenStop-12439.test.tsx`，预期 5 条全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #28084

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Ruling-ref: 6522899149 (maintainer, letter B)

## What changes

All in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/` (app-shell is private; it ships inside `@object-ui/console`), plus changesets:

- **`HIDDEN_POLL_MS` 60_000 to 180_000** in `sharedUserFeeds.ts`. A hidden tab now polls the inbox and approvals feeds every 3 minutes against the 1-minute foreground. Its docblock is rewritten: slower-when-hidden is the rule since #4225; the scheduler reads visibility when it arms, so the foreground tick already armed at the moment of hiding still fires once; the objectui#12439 full stop after `HIDDEN_POLL_STOP_MS` (10 minutes) is unchanged. The module header's "A forgotten tab goes quiet" section names the new cadence.
- **What is now true, stated where it was wrong.** `useInboxArrivalNotifier.ts` header: a desktop notification can be "up to about three minutes late" (was "about a minute"). `.changeset/27626-record-open-requests.md` (unreleased): "still stop in a hidden tab" is corrected in place to "every three minutes while the tab is hidden (and not at all once it has been hidden for ten minutes)".
- **Unchanged, per the ruling:** the 10-minute window and the full stop after it, the one immediate read per feed on return, the desktop notification and its toggle. No new knob, no per-feed rule.
- New changeset `.changeset/28084-hidden-tab-bell-cadence.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell: patch`).

No i18n key, no export from a published package, no metadata change.

## Tests

- New case in `sharedUserFeeds.hiddenStop-12439.test.tsx`, fake timers plus `visibilitychange`: both feeds mounted in a visible tab, the tab hidden 30 s in. Each feed reads once at the already-armed foreground tick, then nothing until each full 180 s has passed, then one read: 4 reads per feed in the 10 hidden minutes (10 at the old cadence), nothing after the 10th minute, no timer left armed, and exactly one read per feed on return.
- The existing hidden-cadence cases restate `HIDDEN_POLL_MS` as 180_000 (`sharedUserFeeds.hiddenStop-12439`, `sharedInboxFeed.cadence-7249`); their arithmetic already derives from the constant.

## Pending release note corrected in place (confirmation for `check-empty-changeset`)

`check-empty-changeset` stays red on this PR, and that is the intended outcome. This PR rewrites one sentence of `.changeset/27626-record-open-requests.md`, a pending note that another PR (#27907) added. The sentence said the feeds "still stop in a hidden tab". On `main` they stop only after 10 continuous hidden minutes, and after this PR they poll every three minutes before that. This is the gate's DELIBERATE CORRECTION class, not a filename collision. Restoring the base text would publish a false sentence. The correction was ordered by the maintainer's ruling 6522899149 on #28084 (execution parameter 3). Only that one clause changed. The note's other bullets and its front matter are unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- [x] **With the tab hidden, the feeds poll at the agreed hidden cadence (180 s) from the moment it hides.** Pinned by the new case: one already-armed foreground tick, then 180 s spacing, at most 4 reads per feed before the 10-minute stop, none after.
- [x] **On becoming visible, one read per feed.** Pinned by the same case and by the existing return case.
- An inbox tick is two requests (messages, then receipts when there is a window to join); an approvals tick is one. Per hidden tab, the first 10 hidden minutes go from up to 10 ticks per feed to at most 4.
- The push-channel seam of #27626 (`setUserFeedPushChannelOpen`) is untouched: while a host reports an open channel neither feed polls, hidden or not. No host opens one today.
